stick.hat.trim.name: B2 hat (4-way)
stick.hat.trim.note: B2 hat: ribbed cap in the angled housing on the left of the head

stick.trigger.name: Trigger
stick.trigger.note: folding metal trigger hanging below the hat housing (seen from behind)

stick.pinky.lever.name: Paddle switch
stick.pinky.lever.note: metal pinky lever at the bottom front

stick.pinky.button.name: Ring finger button
stick.pinky.button.note: round side button at mid grip (the grip's only side button); 'Ring finger button' by elimination

stick.gimbal.name: Stick (roll / pitch)
stick.gimbal.note: grip connector; add-on grip, base not on the photo

stick.button.thumb.1.name: B1 button
stick.button.thumb.1.note: round button with metal ring on top of the head = bomb release button; 'B1' by elimination

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), add-on grip seen from the rear left (thumb side), front to the left: round button on top, hat in the angled housing on the left of the head, folding trigger hanging below the housing, side button at mid grip, metal pinky lever at the bottom front
mappingSource: catalog only (vkb.json: control names from the MobiFlight Gladiator EVO KG12 map https://github.com/MobiFlight/MobiFlight-Connector/blob/main/src/MobiFlightConnector/Joysticks/vkbsim/vkbsim_gladiator_evo_kg12.joystick.json; no Gunfighter numbering, parts have no inputs); physical controls from the product page https://vkbsimcontrollers.com/products/kg12-gf-gen-2-add-on-grip-for-gunfighter-iv-us (folding metal trigger, pinky metal lever (button), bomb release button, 8-way hat, side button). vkbsimcontrollers.com/pages/downloads has no KG12 template.
note: Catalog-to-control matching follows the product page list: B2 hat = the ribbed hat in the angled housing (product page: 8-way, catalog: 4-way), paddle switch = metal pinky lever, trigger = folding metal trigger, B1 = bomb release button on top of the head, 'Ring finger button' = the side button at mid grip. The last two are matched by elimination (the grip has exactly these two plain buttons) and could be the other way round. gallery-4 (left side view) shows the folding trigger fully (pivot at the top front, 0.335 0.17) but the hat cap faces away; main shows all six parts.
